text:
morgan: Quick follow-up to the Kernel Selection & Attention RFC — we need a clear rollout control plan for feature flags / per-model enablement and graceful fallback kernels. Posting a proposed checklist.

jia: +1 need this. Is the idea to gate at model-config level or routing-layer? My vote: both — model-config for default, routing override for emergency.

sam: Agree with jia. Also we need metrics hooks: kernel_accept_rate, fallback_rate, latency_p50/p95, and a correctness proxy (sampled outputs similarity).

oliver: Suggestion: add an ops-only override flag in the control plane for immediate disable. Should be an immutable emergency path so it bypasses canary rules.

morgan: Draft rollout controls (proposal):
1) feature_flag scope: [global, project, model_id]
2) per-model kernel_enable: boolean + version tag
3) staged rollout: dev -> canary(1%) -> canary(10%) -> ramp
4) safety fallback chains: preferred_kernel -> compatible_fallbacks ordered
5) emergency_off: immediate routing to fallback (ops-only)
6) telemetry: counters + sampled traces + human-readable exec plan in logs

anya: Can we add automated rollback triggers? e.g., if fallback_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency regresses > 30% for 10m -> auto-roll back to previous kernel/version.

sam: Yes. Also add quality regression metric: embed-based divergence on a fixed eval prompt set. If > thresh -> block rollout.

morgan: Implementation notes: we should store flags in config-db (per-model config row) and expose a read-cache in the router. Router should evaluate scope and routing policies with a consistent hash for percentage canary.

oliver: About compatibility: we need a small manifest per kernel that lists supported ops/quantization/seq_len. Router can use that to decide compatible_fallbacks.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by morgan for rollout-control service. CI checks: linters, unit tests, migration preview.

jia: Action items:
- morgan: write a tiny RFC appendix with rollout state machine and API (start/cancel/force). due EOD Fri.
- sam: prototype telemetry queries for rollback triggers (promql examples). due Mon.
- oliver: kernel-manifest schema PR. due Tue.
- anya: ops emergency playbook draft. due Wed.

morgan: I'll attach a sample config snippet here — internal format suggestion:
```
{
  "model_id": "gptx-13b-v2",
  "kernel_policy": {
    "enabled": true,
    "preferred": "attn-optimized-v3",
    "fallbacks": ["attn-compat-v1","generic-cpu"],
    "rollout": {"stage": "canary","percent": 1},
    "auto_rollback": {"p95_latency_pct": 30, "fallback_rate_pct": 0.5}
  }
}
```

anya: This looks good. Let's keep rollout percent as integer 0-100 and document semantics for consistent-hash bucketing.

sam: One more: logs should include chosen_kernel and reason (preferred|fallback|force) for every request sample when sampled.

morgan: OK will include those logging fields in the RFC appendix. If no objections I’ll open the follow-up RFC and the rollout-control service ticket tomorrow morning.

jia: no objections from me. :thumbsup:

oliver: +1

anya: +1

morgan: Thanks — will ping when PR exists.
